answer_1.quote: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities to perform tasks within digital environments.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are GUI actions (e.g., click, scroll, input) that navigate through mobile interfaces to complete user tasks.

answer_2.quote: We use three metrics for evaluation. • Task Success Rate evaluates GUI trajectories at the task level. • Task Level Accuracy evaluates whether each GUI trajectory is consistent with the golden trajectory. • Step Level Accuracy evaluates whether each generated action is consistent with the golden action at the step level.

answer_3.quote: The judger is a model-based module that assesses whether executing action a i t leads to an error page and if it improves the likelihood of achieving the task goal.
